notenoughitems.configuration.title: NotEnoughItems Settings
notenoughitems.configuration.panelEnable: Show the item panel, bookmarks and the other NEI panels next to container screens.
notenoughitems.configuration.itemPresenc: Ingredients of a crafting recipe while the mouse is on its + button: 0 Off, 1 Icon, 2 Highlight (red = missing, green = you have it).
notenoughitems.configuration.recipeGhost: While the mouse is on a crafting recipe's +, draw the ingredients faded over the open screen's crafting grid. Off by default: the recipe window covers that grid.
notenoughitems.configuration.slotHighlig: Also mark the ingredients you have, not only the missing ones.
notenoughitems.configuration.search.tool: How the item search reads the text (NEI's inventory.search options).
notenoughitems.configuration.patternMode: 0 Plain, 1 Extended (? and * wildcards, r/regex/), 2 Regex, 3 Extended+ (expressions with | - { } quotes and /regex/).
notenoughitems.configuration.syncTermina: While an Applied Energistics terminal is open, typing in its search field also types in NEI's search and the other way round.
notenoughitems.configuration.cheatEnable: A plain click on a list item gives it and Shift + click opens recipes (as NEI in cheat mode). Needs creative mode, cheats or operator permission.
notenoughitems.configuration.toolbarInSu: Show the toolbar (time, weather, heal ...) in survival mode too. It is always shown in creative mode. Needs cheats or operator permission.
notenoughitems.configuration.collapsible: Groups similar items (spawn eggs, music discs ...) into one slot of the item list. Alt + click a group opens it; the G button opens all.
Group similar items into one slot of the item list.
Show the group's own name instead of the first item's name while a group is collapsed.
Background colour of an open group, as #AARRGGBB (alpha, red, green, blue in hex).
Background colour of a closed group, as #AARRGGBB (alpha, red, green, blue in hex).
What you can craft from your inventory, shown above the history panel.
notenoughitems.configuration.craftablesP: Show what you can craft from your inventory (crafting table and inventory grid recipes).
notenoughitems.configuration.craftablesR: How many rows the craftables panel may use.
notenoughitems.configuration.craftablesF: Only show recipes you marked as favorite (the heart).
notenoughitems.configuration.craftablesC: Colour of the dashed line above the panel, as #AARRGGBB.
notenoughitems.configuration.quantity.to: The - / + field under the item list.
notenoughitems.configuration.showItemQua: Show the quantity field under the item list: how many items a click on a list item gives.
notenoughitems.configuration.itemQuantit: How many items a click on a list item gives (0 = one stack). The field under the item list changes this too.
notenoughitems.configuration.itemzoom.to: Shows the hovered item enlarged beside the window.
notenoughitems.configuration.itemZoomEna: Show the hovered item enlarged beside the window. Shift + the toggle key switches it.
notenoughitems.configuration.itemZoomNei: Zoom only items of the item list, history and bookmark panels.
notenoughitems.configuration.itemZoomOnl: Zoom only blocks that are solid.
notenoughitems.configuration.itemZoomPre: Where to show the item when both sides are free: 0 = the side whose panel has fewer items, 1 = left, 2 = right.
notenoughitems.configuration.itemZoomHel: Show the toggle key below the zoomed item.
notenoughitems.configuration.itemZoomAmo: How much of the free side area the item fills, in thousandths. The zoom in / out keys change this too.
notenoughitems.configuration.itemZoomSho: Show the item's name below the zoomed item.
notenoughitems.configuration.itemZoomNam: Colour of the item name, as #AARRGGBB.
notenoughitems.configuration.transfer.to: The wheel over a slot of a container moves single items.
notenoughitems.configuration.mouseWheelT: Wheel over an item slot: wheel down moves one item out (as Shift + click would), wheel up pulls one in.
notenoughitems.configuration.highlight.t: A box with the name of the block you look at.
notenoughitems.configuration.highlightTi: Show the name of the block you look at, with its item, in a box on the screen. A key (numpad 0) switches it.
